name: OpenDART corpCode (bulk entity list) - needs free key
note: Returns a ZIP containing CORPCODE.xml (corp_code, corp_name, corp_eng_name, stock_code, modify_date) for every DART entity. 302 without crtfc_key. Register free at opendart.fss.or.kr.

name: OpenDART company info (identity) - needs free key
note: Replace {corp_code} with an 8-digit DART code from corpCode.xml. Returns jurir_no (corp reg no), bizr_no (business/tax reg no), corp_cls, ceo_nm (PII), est_dt, adres, induty_code. status 900 without key.

name: OpenDART financial statements (full) - needs free key
note: Full financial statements (BS/IS/CIS/CF/SCE) in KRW. reprt_code 11011=annual. fs_div CFS=consolidated/OFS=separate. status 900 without key.

name: NTS business-registration status - needs free data.go.kr key
note: POST body {"b_no":["<10-digit business reg no>"]}. Returns b_stt (active/suspended/closed) + tax_type. 401 '인증키는 필수 항목 입니다' without serviceKey.
